data.one_liner: Trim videos in Flutter on Android, iOS, macOS, and the web
data.what_it_does: Provides a customizable video trimmer UI with playback controls, timeline scrubbing, and video or GIF export. Supports native implementation on Android, iOS, and macOS, and runs via Mediabunny on the web.
use_when: You need a user interface to let users select and trim a portion of a video.
You need cross-platform video trimming supporting mobile, desktop (macOS), and the web.
avoid_when: You only need a background video processing or transcoding pipeline without any UI.
You need advanced non-linear video editing with multi-track timelines and filters.
strengths: Includes customizable trim viewers and playback controls.
Runs natively on mobile and desktop without requiring external FFmpeg binaries.
weaknesses: Requires manual disposal of the Trimmer instance.
Web support depends on browser capability (WebCodecs support).
data.setup_notes: Android minSdk must be at least 24. On macOS, sandboxed apps require the user-selected read-only entitlement. No special Info.plist keys are strictly needed unless using a separate file picker plugin.
